name: reclaim_continuation_v2
objective: Replace threshold-only reclaim logic with an explicit structural state machine.

states.description: Price first dislocates away from a locally inferred level (support/resistance).
A decisive reclaim close returns across the inferred level in the trade direction.
Post-reclaim bars hold the reclaimed side and avoid immediate failure.

constraints: Detector must emit fail_state at first structural failure
Detector must reject when spread gate fails
Detector must not rely on position+bias only
